data_issues.message: stats.json latestYear does not match the max year in trends.json.
trends.json registrations is zero for every year and should not be used as an observed visual variable.
trends.json totalExpenses is zero for every year and should not be used as an observed visual variable.
filing-activity.json contains months beyond the core annual trend range.
Government-entity spending appears to be repeated target-side exposure, not additive lobbying spend.
revolving-door-premium counts are transition events, not unique people.
Legacy fuzzy dedup merges are quarantined and not accepted as silent canonical truth.

visual_encoding.x: UMAP issue-space coordinate or marked inference
visual_encoding.y: UMAP issue-space coordinate or marked inference
visual_encoding.vertical_axis: Three.js Y axis encodes year when the 3D time-stack view is enabled
visual_encoding.node_size: log observed spend or log filings; gov exposure excluded
visual_encoding.shape: uniform round marker; entity type is encoded by color and letter identifier
visual_encoding.arcs: resolved revolving-door flow records with observed, estimated, or unknown transition-year semantics
